command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx node
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli|eval|api" | head -30; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -120; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md | grep -A6 -E "^\`\`\`" | head -30
cd /workspace; env | grep -c MCPJAM; (npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --version || npx -y mcpjam --version) 2>&1 | tail -3;
cd /workspace; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -40

cd /workspace; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals reports; cat > .mcp.json <<'E'
{"mcpServers":{"fixture":{"url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}
E
cat > .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_fixture_add
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: fixture
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_uses_add
    title: uses add for a sum
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17.5 + 24.25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml 2>&1 | tail -5
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --reporter junit-xml --out reports/add.xml 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /workspace; echo $MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md | grep -iE -B2 -A4 "http://|insecure|allow" | head -50

cd /workspace; cat > fwd.js <<'E'
require('net').createServer(c=>{const u=require('net').connect(8765,'fixture');c.pipe(u).pipe(c);c.on('error',()=>{});u.on('error',()=>{})}).listen(18765,'127.0.0.1');
E
nohup node fwd.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 1
export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --reporter junit-xml --out reports/add.xml 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture --reporter junit-xml --out reports/add.xml 2>&1 | tail -20; ls reports

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test --help 2>&1 | grep -iE "project|workspace" ; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud --help 2>&1 | head -30; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud project list 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud whoami 2>&1 | head; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud projects --help 2>&1 | head -15; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud projects list 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project Fixture --reporter junit-xml --out reports/add.xml 2>&1 | tail -5; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --help 2>&1 | head -50; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud servers --help 2>&1 | head -15

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture --server http://fixture:8765/mcp --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/add.json 2>&1 | tail -15; ls reports

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
sed -i 's/name: fixture/name: Arithmetic/' .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture --server server_fixture --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/add.json 2>&1 | tail -15; cat reports/add.json | head -c 1500
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | grep -n -iE -B3 -A12 "toolCall$|kind: toolCall|kind: tool" | head -60

cd /workspace; for p in cli/reference.md sdk/concepts/running-evals.md cli/ci.md inspector/evals.md; do echo "== $p"; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/$p | grep -n -iE "toolCall|kind:|toolResult|jsonPath|outputEquals" | head -12; done
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | sed -n '2440,2500p'

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
python3 - <<'E'
s=open('.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml').read()
i=s.index('    steps:')
s=s[:i]+'''    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: toolCall
        serverName: Arithmetic
        toolName: add
        arguments:
          a: 17.5
          b: 24.25
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolResultContains
          text: "41.75"
'''
open('.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml','w').write(s)
E
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -8
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/running-evals.md | grep -n -B2 -A8 "toolResultContains" | head -50

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/v1
python3 - <<'E'
s=open('.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml').read()
i=s.index('      - id: a1')
s=s[:i]+'''      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
'''
open('.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml','w').write(s)
E
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -3
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture --server server_fixture --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/add.json 2>&1 | tail -8; head -c 1500 reports/add.json
